{{Quote|Jedi! Welcome&mdash;welcome to the, uh, old Galactic Market, uh, sir.|Alec Efran|<ref name="SWTORss" />}}
'''Alec Efran''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], Efran arrested a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Unidentified Gand scavenger|criminal]] who was wanted for questioning by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for the theft of the [[Noetikon of Science]], a special [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. Efran held the Gand until the arrival of the [[Jedi Consular]] [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|This is the, uh, Gand we brought in. He was talking about that Jedi 'holocron' you're all looking for. But he's not exactly, uh, talkative.|Alec Efran|<ref name="SWTORss" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Alec Efran lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], he served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]].<ref name="SWTORss" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Efran fought with and arrested a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Unidentified Gand scavenger|criminal]] who was connected to the theft of one of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] prized special [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]], called [[noetikon]]s, the [[Noetikon of Science]]. He held the Gand in the [[Old Galactic Market]] for questioning by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="SWTORss" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
A young [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] arrived not long afterward to question the Gand. While the Gand had not been forthcoming with Efran, the Consular got him to talk and reveal the Neotikon's location.<ref name="SWTORss" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Hmph. Soft thing can barely speak.''"<br />"''I'm sorry, I just&mdash;I never met a real Jedi up close.|The Barsen'thor, to Alec Efran|<ref name="SWTORss" />}}
A short and younger-looking Human, Efran had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and light-colored skin. While a competent [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who did not have difficulty engaging in fights to make arrests, Efran was uncomfortable around [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], having had little experience interacting with them. When in the presence of a Jedi, Efran spoke more softly than usual and frequently stumbled through his sentences.<ref name="SWTORss" />

==Equipment==
While on duty, Efran wore his [[Coruscant Security Force uniform|CSF uniform]] with a [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]]. He also wore a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], which carried his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]].<ref name="SWTORss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alec Efran appears in the Jedi Consular mission "Secret Signals" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The player undertakes a mission to discover the missing Noetikon of Science and, through the course of the mission, interacts with Efran. Instead of choosing the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] questions and methods during the questioning, the player can opt for more forceful questioning and thereby receive [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points.<ref name="SWTORss" />
